note: The citing work explicitly implements extensions to Larsen and Amarasinghe's SLP algorithm [15] within the TOBEY compiler backend, describing in detail how they adapt and extend the original SLP algorithm to generate Cross, Asymmetric, and Complex SIMD-like instructions for the PowerPC 440 FP2 Core.
title: A high-performance SIMD floating point unit for BlueGene/L: architecture, compilation, and algorithm design
